DIAGNOSIS: No identifiable cardiac or systemic disease on available evaluation; apparently healthy adult presenting for screening ECG in the setting of chronic non-cardiac disability requiring wheelchair use (etiology of mobility impairment undetermined).

Alternatives:
1. Early/subclinical cardiomyopathy (e.g., muscular dystrophy–related) not yet detectable on history or basic labs
2. Spinal cord injury or other chronic neurologic cause of wheelchair dependence with preserved cardiac history
3. Prior orthopedic injury or congenital musculoskeletal condition accounting for wheelchair use without systemic disease
